name: SaveImage
label: Save Image
description: Saves a screenshot of a UI element or region to disk.

fields.name: ImageSource
fields.label: Image Source
fields.description: The source of the image (e.g., screen region, control).

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: Full path where the image will be saved (e.g., C:\temp\image.png).

fields.name: Format
fields.label: Image Format
fields.description: Format of the saved image (e.g., PNG, JPEG). Default: PNG.

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on Error
fields.description: If true, workflow continues even if the request fails.
